title: Protect Smarter, Recover Faster: Your Guide to Data Protection as a Service (eBook)
subject: Protect Smarter, Recover Faster: Your Guide to Data Protection as a Service (eBook)
body:
Hybrid environments are creating new demands for data protection. Customers need simpler ways to protect data, recover quickly and reduce the burden on their teams.

The Protect Smarter, Recover Faster eBook helps you introduce Data Protection as a Service as part of that conversation.

It covers key priorities such as immutable protection, recovery, centralized management and support across hybrid environments.

The opportunity is already packaged for you in the Cyber Risk Mitigation & Recovery campaign. Add your brand, tailor the message and get in front of customers faster.

Activate Campaign Now

Turn data protection challenges into a stronger customer conversation and new business opportunity.

Thank you for being a valued partner!
Partner Marketing Team
